comparison.objective: Fit a funnel and pour beads into a narrow bottle; unlike tuning a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Funnel insertion followed by controlled granular pouring versus hex-key alignment, counterholding, fine adjustment, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: All 24 beads must enter; pouring without the funnel fails, including perfectly aimed pours. Spill/damage details beyond the shortcut tests are not stated.
comparison.reason: It tests tool-mediated granular transfer, not iterative adjustment based on carriage impacts.
